description: POA swap offers seen on the network, newest first, with the current swap availability. Read-only: it never places or takes offers. Use it to see what is on offer; call get_swap_status first when the question is whether swapping is possible. Each offer carries money_moved as in get_swap_offer.

limit.description: maximum offers to return (1 to 200, default 20)

status.description: offer status to list (default open); delisted = gone from the network's book before expiry; refunded = open at a segment boundary, escrow returned there (refund_basis)

name: list_swap_offers
title: Swap offers
